[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-h8[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Retire the parallel-suite flake class (sase-ct) by making it [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]reproducible, fixing it by mechanism, and gating regressions[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The default parallel test lanes stop producing unattributable [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one-node failures. The flake class becomes reproducible on demand [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of only under accidental host load, every node the durable [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]health store calls a reproducible flake is fixed at its mechanism [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rather than one-at-a-time as it surfaces, and a committed baseline [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]gate fails the build when a new flake node appears — so sase-ct can[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]close on a measured, enforced criterion instead of on "the node [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]named in the latest reopen is fixed".[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]parallel_suite_flake_class.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A contention harness for the default (non-visual) lane[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]harness[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]harness: add a `just test-contention` recipe and `run_pytest` mode that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]oversubscribes a pinned CPU set the way `test-visual-contention` already[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]does for the PNG lane, plus a repeat/soak knob and a per-node failure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tally, so the class can be reproduced and a fix can be falsified on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]demand.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One bounded-wait primitive for raw-pilot tests[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]waits[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]waits: publish a single supported bounded-wait helper for tests that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drive a raw Textual pilot instead of `AcePage`, retire the four ad-hoc [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`_wait_until` copies onto it, and document when a bare `pause()` is and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is not sufficient.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Measured classification of every flake node[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]triage[dim] · [dim][/dim]after harness[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]triage: run the contention harness to produce an empirical failure [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]corpus, reconcile it against the durable health store's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]reproducible-flake set, and commit a triage table that assigns every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]node a mechanism family and a named fix shape, so the remediation phases[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]work from measurement rather than from the bead's anecdotes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix the off-pump settle-gap family[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]pump[dim] · [dim][/dim]after triage, waits[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pump: fix every triaged node whose failure is a single `pause()` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]standing in for work that runs off the Textual message pump, by waiting [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]on the observable end state with the shared bounded-wait primitive.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix the real-wall-clock-threshold family[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]clock[dim] · [dim][/dim]after triage, waits[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]clock: remove the dependence on real elapsed wall-clock time from the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stall watchdog tests and the other triaged deadline-shaped nodes, by [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]driving them from an injectable time source or a load-normalized budget [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of loosening assertions again.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix the ACE fixture-state and cross-test-leakage family[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]fixture[dim] · [dim][/dim]after triage, waits[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]fixture: fix the triaged ACE nodes whose injected fixture state is [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]overwritten by a queued repaint or leaks across tests, by making state [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]injection settle-verified and the affected panes isolated per test.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fix the non-ACE store, tooling, and subprocess family[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]tooling[dim] · [dim][/dim]after triage, waits[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tooling: fix the triaged non-ACE nodes — bead-store clusters, selection [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and run_pytest tooling tests, the coverage-context cache, and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]subprocess/pipe races — while leaving the bead-mutation lock timeout [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tracked separately under sase-e2 alone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]A committed flake baseline that fails the build on new flakes[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pump, clock, fixture, tooling[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate: commit a flake baseline file and a gate that fails when the health[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]store's reproducible-flake set exceeds it, wire the gate into the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exhaustive lane and a CI contention job, and add the lint check that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stops the retired ad-hoc wait helpers from coming back.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Land the epic and close sase-ct on a measured criterion[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]land: run the exit criterion on the combined tree, file any residue with[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]/sase_new_task, and close sase-ct with a note that states the root cause[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of the class and the enforced criterion that replaces hand-adjudication.[/#D7D7AF]
